spiritgiven.comments:
Main issues - travels, not dropping with double team calls, multiple interjections from sideline when perspective not asked, not adherent to time limits - coach told players to continue with discussions despite 3 whistles for time limit reached (?to try and expend more time even with just a travel call). 

Discussion with their spirit captains before and at half time, however minimal improvement seen.
Calls were resolved in a timely manner even when requiring a translator. Positive game with lots of hi-fives, thanks!
Great game with players listening to our perspective with good resolution of calls, thank you!

Great game! There was good communication between both teams and we felt you were very fair minded with discussing what stall to come in on when there was a stoppage and checking in to make sure we are all in correct place, calling travels on self and correcting that. Thank you!
Thank you France for an intense game. An improvement seen in both sides regards to spirit compared to the last game. Some great comms with calls and good discussions had.

spiritreceived.comments: Very spirited team and very fair-minded game!

Regarding the travel calls: There were increasingly frequent travel calls when the scores were close. When making these calls, it would be helpful to be clear about who is traveling and how. Overall, the team was very spirited, and after discussing this with the spirit captain, the situation improved. :)
Please be mindful of sideline involvement with calls. There was an instance with 5 sideline players saying a disc was out straight away. Thank you for the game

Thank you again for this game and congratulations on the win. We forgot to mention this in the spirit circle - we felt there were unnecessary fouls & body contact. We felt there was a general insufficient rule knowledge which stopped the flow of the game, and can easily be avoided for smoother resolutions. 
As we mentioned, we are disappointed that the game did not stay consistent spirit wise and in fair mindedness. We decided not to take a point away but think it important to mention again.

There are multiple positive things. Although our Japanese team couldn't speak English very well, we could really feel their attitude and willingness to listen. They also always communicated slowly when they spoke English. And it was great to see them high-fiving and congratulating each other in between points.Thank you, New Zealand!

Sometimes called fast count after the throw and stall count but then retracted the call. One incident where our d called a trip foul and the other person said it should be a pick and we didn’t feel like it was a pick

Thank you for the game, it’s always very Tough and intense. About the 1 in fairmindeness, we still Felt that some calls without much influence about the play  were made in important moments ( when they Weren’t called when you were leading). Nevertheless the communication was still so Good and Even Been improved since the last game. Congrats for your hard work and Good luck for the rest.
Thank you for such an exciting game. Your positive attitude inspired us a lot. There were some calls made from both teams but were solved cleanly thanks to your communication.
